verdict.rationale: The Skills format is an open, portable spec (agentskills.io) — plain SKILL.md folders with no Anthropic-specific runtime — and a hands-on probe shows a third-party CLI (`npx skills add ... -a claude-code`) installing skills with a harness-selection flag, implying support for targeting different agents. However, all first-party Anthropic docs (code.claude.com, platform.claude.com) only describe installation/use inside Claude Code or the Claude API/container, with no vendor-provided instructions for Codex, Cursor, or other harnesses. Missing for 10: official multi-harness install docs from Anthropic, confirmed working install/run in Codex or Cursor, and per-harness invocation guidance beyond the inferred CLI flag.
